description_en: Creates a server application that processes upstream messages by calling CreateUpstreamAppServer
description_zh: 调用CreateUpstreamAppServer创建处理上行消息的服务端应用
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc create-upstream-app-server --project-id CS1HMVRF --name testServer --tags tag1,tag2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUpstreamAppServer

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IoVCC project
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the server application.

The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores, and cannot exceed 15 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
服务端应用名称。

由字母、数字和下划线组成，不超过15个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The upstream business message tags, which help the application server classify and process upstream messages. Separate multiple tags with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 上行业务消息tag，方便应用服务器端对上行消息分类处理。多个tag通过英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: tags

Id.description_en: The ID of the upstream server application
